objective: End primary Gemini PSTN calls after the agent completes an explicit closing farewell, even without caller confirmation or an end_call tool
acceptance_criteria: A completed terminal agent farewell arms hangup without a separate caller goodbye
The carrier disconnect waits for farewell playback to drain
Caller barge-in and current speech prevent an unwanted disconnect
Questions, quoted examples, ordinary thanks, and interrupted responses do not trigger the new fallback
English, Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, and Kannada closing phrases are recognized
New trigger is limited to Gemini PSTN; default validator behavior and admin call-end policies remain unchanged
